response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, polyglot senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and infrastructure, strong TDD/testing culture, and current hands-on experience with TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent tooling (MCP) at re:cinq. His depth in architecture, DevOps, and cross-language work strongly matches the seniority and technical breadth required, though his resume shows more Ember.js than React and no explicit Nest.js, Kotlin, or Vitest experience, which are core to this role's primary stack.
strengths: 15+ years of full-stack experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure with strong architecture and DevOps skills
Deep testing/TDD advocate, having built testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts) and run TDD workshops
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly relevant to the AI agent development requirement
concerns: Primary frontend experience is with Ember.js rather than React, which is central to the required stack
No explicit mention of Nest.js, Kotlin, or Vitest, all listed as core/secondary technologies for the role
Long history of short-to-mid tenure roles (many 1-2 year stints) could raise questions about retention
